definition: Detecting signs of pneumonia in chest X-rays — a flagship medical imaging task and a cautionary example for clinical ML evaluation.
details: Detecting signs of pneumonia in chest X-rays — a flagship medical imaging task and a cautionary example for clinical ML evaluation.

explainer.lead: Pneumonia detection is the task of finding signs of pneumonia in chest X-rays. It is a flagship medical imaging task and a cautionary example for clinical ML evaluation.

tiers.eli5: It is teaching a computer to spot pneumonia in lung X-ray pictures — and learning why judging such a system is harder than it looks.
tiers.practitioner: It serves as a benchmark medical imaging task; the cautionary part is that clinical ML evaluation can mislead if done carelessly.
tiers.paperLevel: The task is detecting signs of pneumonia in chest X-rays; it is noted as a cautionary example for clinical ML evaluation rather than a fixed formula.

explainer.example: A model is trained on chest X-rays to flag signs of pneumonia, and its clinical evaluation is scrutinized as a warning case.
